decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Dragonite at 88/166, Multiscale broken. Dragapult at 80%. ESpeed +1 Atk: 204*1.5=306 Atk, ESpeed 80 BP... Dragapult LO special. ESpeed damage: roughly 306*80/... estimate ~45-55%? Dragapult HP ~163-195, at 80% ≈ 130-156. ESpeed likely ~40-50% → not KO. Dragon Pulse again would KO Dragonite (88 HP, ~78 damage last time at full multiscale... actually 88 damage taken at full HP with multiscale, so without it ~176 → KO). So Dragonite dies to another Dragon Pulse unless ESpeed KOs. Better: ESpeed now to chip; if not KO, we lose Dragonite. Alternatively switch to Gholdengo — resists Dragon Pulse (immune? No, Ghost/Steel: Dragon neutral). Gholdengo takes Dragon Pulse neutrally, ~fine, and can Recover. But Dragapult may have Shadow Ball/U-turn. Gholdengo walls Dragon Pulse, threatens Shadow Ball back (Dragapult weak to Ghost). Switch to Gholdengo seems safest.

Actually ESpeed at +1: 306 Atk vs Def 85-139, 80 BP, neutral. Damage ≈ ((306*80)/... rough: 42*306*80/(139*... )). Estimate: ~35-45% of max. Dragapult at 80% → likely survives with ~35-45%. Then Dragonite faints. So switch Gholdengo.

decisions.thought: 79% MOVE: shadowball, 20% MOVE: phantomforce, 1% SWITCH: metagross

Gholdengo tanks Dragon Pulse (took ~22 with LO recoil on them). Shadow Ball is super effective vs Dragapult; two hits likely KO (they're at 70%, LO draining ~10%/turn). Their backline: likely Scizor/Metagross steels—save Make It Rain for them. Dragonite at 53% saved for late. Plan: Shadow Ball now; Recover when low; beware Cursed Body disabling.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Shadow Ball pressure; Nasty Plot risky if they stay. Shadow Ball 2HKOs Dragapult likely. Just attack.

Beware Bullet Punch priority vs Gholdengo.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Gholdengo at 10%, Metagross likely faster or could KO. Recover to 50%, but Metagross hits hard (Zen Headbutt/EQ—EQ hits Gholdengo neutrally? Gholdengo is Steel/Ghost, EQ neutral). Shadow Ball is SE vs Metagross. At 20/194, one hit likely KOs. Recover first? Metagross could KO anyway. Better: Recover to survive, or Shadow Ball to damage. Metagross 100% HP, Shadow Ball ~35-40% — need 3 hits. Risky. Switch to Dragonite to preserve Gholdengo? Dragonite at 53%, Multiscale broken; Metagross likely has Ice Punch/Zen Headbutt. Hmm.

I think Recover: heal to ~117/194, tank a hit, then Shadow Ball spam. But Metagross attack could do ~60-70%. Alternatively Shadow Ball now while they might set up. Recover seems safest to keep Gholdengo alive as steel-check.
